verdict.summary: The documentation-only decision remains correct and complete under the adversarial trust-plane lens. It makes acceptance conditional on proving repository publicity fail-closed, using one boolean credential-shape predicate over the complete stored representation, refusing whole writes on a match, and pinning rotating cache reachability and restore fallback behavior at the YAML seam with exact-match tests. It explicitly distinguishes reachability from physical storage retention, requires a separate maintainer choice for platform retention versus authenticated cleanup, preserves least-privilege concerns, and includes non-vacuous bidirectional and mutation-test requirements. Unverified platform claims are labelled and the decision is deliberately not dependent on them. No blocker, major, or other diff-supported issue remains. With no prior-round findings and no new findings, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
